theoryOfChange: By understanding grammar, rhetoric, and logic, a student is equipped with the tools to approach any discipline. Zaytuna College seeks to recapture this tradition through both the BA and MA programs, with a curriculum that draws both on the Muslim classics and on the Euro-American classical tradition that grew from and alongside it.
